column3: A Hong Kong nexus is required, but which one depends on the route, and one route does not need an entity to apply: "Individual Applicants: Principal applicant must be Hong Kong ID Card holder. Company Applicants: Limited company registered and incorporated in Hong Kong upon admission." The founder holds no HK ID card, so the individual route is walled. The company route requires the HK company only upon admission, not to apply - so applying is possible, but accepting means incorporating in Hong Kong.
